answer: The sparrow check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. Grading runs by quorum — several unconnected graders score each submission, and outliers are discarded. Under the tundra, a farm that grades its own clones still loses: its votes are a minority against honest graders, and disagreement flags its whole cluster for review. The anchor does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
